about: The startup dashboard: one page, rebuilt from the repo and GitHub on every merge to main and every hour by the dashboard workflow. Only the founder edits this file (the deploy gate). host: where it is served, for example pm.example.com; empty means it is built but never deployed. cloudflare_pages_project: the Cloudflare Pages project that serves it. The workflow deploys only when a Cloudflare Access application with a login policy covers both the host and <project>.pages.dev, and checks after each deploy that an anonymous visitor gets the login page, not the dashboard. Setup: the handbook, 'The startup dashboard'.
